name: gel-ram
description: Knowledge printed into memory as fixed Q8 records and read back exactly: one record, four exact views, a refusal instead of changed bytes, nothing confirmed lost to kill -9. Toward hardware-level memory computation (not established) and a Polish/English text AI that says UNKNOWN when it does not know. Noncommercial: GEL RAM NCRL 1.0.

paragraphs: GEL RAM prints knowledge into memory as fixed Q8 records, instead of training it into model weights, and reads the records back exactly, working toward hardware-level memory computation. The goal is a text AI that answers in Polish and English from what it holds, or says it does not know.

The step that prints text into records is private, so the Q8 records in this checkout hold synthetic values or literal bytes, and its tools do not answer natural-language questions. This repository does not establish hardware-level memory computation (claim registry: NOTESTABLISHED); the text AI is a goal, not a result.
GEL's own answers come from a private implementation and its bank, so they cannot be re-run from this checkout. Everything around them can:
